description: This file implements the QuicChromiumAlarmFactory class and the QuicChromeAlarm class, which are used to create and manage alarms within the QUIC protocol implementation in Chromium. It includes definitions for setting, canceling, and firing alarms, integrating with Chromium's task runner and timer system.

classes.name: QuicChromeAlarm
classes.description: A custom alarm class that integrates Chromium's timer system with QUIC's alarm interface, allowing alarms to be scheduled and triggered within Chromium's task and timer infrastructure.

classes.name: QuicChromiumAlarmFactory
classes.description: A factory class responsible for creating instances of QuicChromeAlarm, managing their lifecycle, and associating them with specific task runners and clocks.

methods.name: QuicChromeAlarm
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the alarm with a clock, task runner, and delegate, setting up the timer callback.

methods.name: SetImpl
methods.description: Sets the alarm to fire at the specified deadline by starting the underlying Chromium timer.

methods.name: CancelImpl
methods.description: Cancels the alarm by stopping the underlying Chromium timer.

methods.name: OnAlarm
methods.description: Callback invoked when the timer fires; checks if the deadline has been reached and fires the alarm or retries if necessary.

methods.name: NowTicks
methods.description: Returns the current time in ticks, converted from the clock's current time.

methods.name: QuicChromiumAlarmFactory
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the factory with a task runner and clock.

methods.name: CreateAlarm
methods.description: Creates a new QuicChromeAlarm instance, either within a provided arena or directly.
